description: Save one school's policy after the server checks it. Every source is a capture_file held for the school, one playlist_policy_open named or one playlist_find_pages found, and a quote of 300 characters or fewer copied verbatim from that capture's cleaned text; the quote check is exact, with no fuzzy matching. The server also checks that every course code is one of the school's CourseShelf learning units, every award_title appears in the award_types section, and every min_credits is a positive number. A designation's quote must contain its name or its abbreviation, and every course in its courses list must be supported, in one of two ways. One: its code and the designation's abbreviation or name appear together in one quote, the source's or one in the designation's optional evidence list. Two: Where a school lists a designation's courses under one heading, quote the heading as the designation's source and the course rows as evidence from the same page. A row counts where it sits under that heading and before the next heading, and one evidence quote may show several rows. Where a school defines a designation by subject and level instead of a list of courses, give subjects: each rule is a subject prefix, an optional minimum course number, and its own source, whose quote shows them. It never alters the policy. It returns policy_id, status, and every error in plain words: a policy with errors is saved as rejected, so correct it and save again.

built_by.description: Who built this policy: a short string naming the agent and model. Stored with the saved policy. A save without it is rejected.

award_title.description: An award title exactly as the award_types section gives it

other.description: Plain sentences: the award's other institution-wide conditions

source.description: Where the school published it: the capture, named as the manifest or playlist_find_pages names it, and a verbatim passage of 300 characters or fewer from that capture's cleaned text

abbreviation.description: Optional: the designation's printed abbreviation, exactly as printed. The designation's quote must contain its name or this abbreviation.

courses.description: The course codes that carry the designation

designation.description: The area phrase exactly as printed

evidence.description: Optional: more sources for a designation whose courses one quote cannot cover, each a capture_file and a quote of 300 characters or fewer. Each evidence quote must show the course code and the designation's abbreviation or name together, as the school printed them, or show the course's row under the heading the designation's source quotes, on the same page.
